protocol.method: Same bundled Chromium, viewport 1500x1000, selected PDF extractor and inputs for old TS and Rust. Dedicated browser process tree RSS sampled every 100 ms, includes workers, WASM and GPU but can double-count shared pages and miss short-lived peaks. First navigation/load, each task stages (Rust inputAdmission includes page validation/hash before compare; TS validation/snapshot happen after full input, so individual phase columns have different boundaries) and full display completion, sequential tasks, close workers, query/search, and cancel latency recorded. OS release does not imply immediate memory return. No performance target relaxed.
